note: A run fails when the metric exceeds max(baseline * (1 + relative_pct/100), baseline + absolute_us). The absolute floor exists because p99 on this rig is around 9 us, where a 20 percent relative threshold alone is 1.8 us, below the 1 us bin resolution of the instrument, and the check would flap on quantisation. The max threshold is looser in both terms because worst case on a laptop under a firmware floor of 22 to 29 us is genuinely more variable than p99.
